description: Step into a dangerous Open World adventure where every monster on Azeroth becomes Elite. Choose your difficulty, embark solo or with a party of up to five, and set off. In Adventure Mode, Quest experience is greatly increased and you can find dungeon loot off of monsters you slay. However, monsters have more dangerous behavior, increased health, and increased damage. Will you rise to the challenge and claim your destiny, or fall to a deadlier Azeroth? Welcome to Adventure Mode!
